properties.site-address: St Aidan's Hotel, St Aidan's, Seahouses
properties.notes: Opportunity for redevelopment of existing hotel, most likely through conversion. A number of proposal are relevant to site. Scheme involving the conversion and extension of existing hotel to provide 6 units was granted consent but never started and has now lapsed (11/02747/FUL). This was a renewal of previous consent (08/B/0541). A development of relatively high density would be fitting for a conversion scheme and given the location.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
